# Institute for Human Stewardship

> The Institute for Human Stewardship ("IHS") is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to saving souls through the cultivation of family and culture. IHS is headquartered in Watertown, WI.

Last updated 2026-09-29.
